decisions.summary: LPBF Ti-6Al-4V, 316L and Inconel 718 records bind to open public allowables with unresolved-allowable flags that block unqualified fatigue claims. Wrought data is never presented as as-built.
Manufacturing gates (build fit, downskin, support access, powder escape, tool swept volume) are evaluated in simulation on the CAD and mesh corpus. No physical machining.
Published open LPBF roughness ranges by build angle and finish class bind to variant identities, with cross-discipline invalidation.
Rescoped to pre-order metrology and uncertainty-budget specification in software. No vendor orders or vendor contact.

Open published hydrocyclone and swirl benchmark tables and curves (Hsieh 1988, Bai, Young, Zhou) are ingested with provenance digests, station coordinates, boundary conditions and matched or unresolved input declarations. Cost $0.

Velocity profiles, reverse core, pressure drop and split ratio are checked against public stations. Numerical, input and experimental discrepancy are separated on coverage cards, with the high-order CFD reference labelled as a proxy.

Anisotropic dispersion and LES unresolved-energy partition are checked against native resolved-turbulence runs on xbabe1/xbabe2, with zero double-counting. Labelled a numerical carrier-field substitute, never physical PIV or LDV.
Daughter droplet mass conservation is enforced with no hidden clipping. Uncalibrated exposure rates are bracketed by off, calibrated-on and adverse bounds.
The four bounded objectives and no-regression gates are evaluated on accepted native CFD/FEA envelopes. The 0.35/0.20/0.30/0.15 weights remain a proposed sensitivity profile only.
Wet modes, fixtures, modal mesh convergence and broadband forced response come from coupled CFD wall-pressure spectra and acoustic/added-mass FEA on xbabe1/xbabe2. No physical measurement.

Finite-life fatigue estimands and Goodman/Walker corrections bind to open-literature LPBF S-N curves and passport defect bounds. Labelled bounded literature or proxy estimates, not coupon certification.

CT registration, feature detectability and roughness perturbation are qualified on synthetic geometric deviation fields, with nominal and as-built subject identities kept separate. Affected physics is re-run on xbabe1/xbabe2.
Correlated geometry, load and material bounds propagate through the native FEA/CFD pipeline. Deterministic corner scenarios are kept distinct from p95 reliability claims.
Governing structural observables are cross-checked between primary 3D continuum FEA and an independent refined or second-order route. Discrepancy is recorded as an uncertainty contribution.

The independent-label dataset comes from native high-fidelity CFD/FEA evaluations, grouped by family and lineage split. It is kept separate from sandbox descriptors and tagged as numerical oracle labels.
Interface state at admitted cut planes is extracted from native full-geometry simulations, with independent mass, momentum and oil conservation checks.
A preregistered, diverse full-liner corpus with family-separated held-out cases is generated under Lease renewal-004 on xbabe1/xbabe2, with coverage and gap metadata.

Paper and report claims bind to typed observation, subject, scenario, estimand, unit and tier manifests (simulation, proxy, public_benchmark). The planted-error negatives are not yet executed, so V5-28-04 verification remains open.
The non-hydrocyclone bracket contract uses standard open bolt and support geometry, open material properties and explicit fixture load cases, with zero hydrocyclone constants.
Synthetic delayed and censored multi-stream telemetry reduction is accepted with substitute provenance. Physical wet-rig sensor ingestion is rescoped to the post-manufacturing phase.

End-to-end software traceability binds simulated as-built deviations, coupon and CT schema records and physics re-evaluation to unique specimen passports. Physical specimen tap and proof testing are rescoped to the post-manufacturing phase.

Approved within existing compute only. External spend is $0. Estimated internal compute is about 1.5 GPU-hours and 12 CPU-core-hours on xbabe1/xbabe2/xbabe4 under Lease renewal-004. The separate owner budget record in OWNER_APPROVAL_DOSSIERS dossier 1 is not written here.

Delegate governance sign-off for the frozen study arms, estimands, seeds, power, normalization, confirmation budget and hashed policy. Reviewed against the R003 integration receipt (sha256 70cef07d32a5691b1b44d8d408b79bc5568acfdc0773b46d2962400d599a1a2d). Owner dossier 2 remains unsigned in the repo.

Delegate governance sign-off for internal reproducible review bundles, allowlisted offline reproduction and the inventory. Third-party licensing and external publication remain reserved to Jepson. Owner dossier 3 remains unsigned in the repo, and its manufacturing versus publication scope mismatch is unresolved.

Delegate governance sign-off for internal protocol closure: containment review, comparator, pilot-power quantities, blinded A/B/A blocks and calibration/holdout separation. Vendor orders remain reserved to Jepson. The protocol stays an unsigned draft until the owner signature is recorded in the protocol file.

Delegate governance sign-off for private dossier storage and the allowlisted public export gate. Outside filing, publication and commercial licensing remain reserved to Jepson. Owner dossier 5 remains unsigned in the repo.

Approved at $0 to stage open-source CUDA runtime and library components on xbabe1 (RTX 4090, lambda-stack-cuda 12.8), without a reboot and without disturbing running services. JopeDime I65 and I66 are also covered but are not Joil tasks.
